label: Whole mouse brain (BrainGlobe test data)
description: Cleared whole mouse brain, downsampled to 50 × 40 × 40 µm (orientation psl), that brainreg's tests register. CC0, BrainGlobe test data.
expectedResult: In about two minutes, the Allen atlas labels over the brain and a table of region volumes; voxels are too coarse for cell detection, which stays off.

label: Cell detection crop (BrainGlobe test data)
description: 26 full-resolution planes (5 × 2 × 2 µm) of a cleared mouse brain's signal channel that cellfinder's tests detect cells in. CC0, BrainGlobe test data.
expectedResult: 38 cell candidates, the same as cellfinder's detection, marked over the stack and listed in cells.csv. A crop cannot be registered, so registration stays off.
